model_node_inventory.description: PowerOnDuration is the duration the Device has been powered. The main purpose is to determine the time in which degradation of the Device occurred. The details, when the time is counted, is implementation-specific. Companion specifications can define specific rules. Typically, when the Device has supply voltage and the main CPU is running, the time is counted. This can include any kind of sleep mode, but cannot include pure Wake on LAN. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted. The PowerOnDuration is provided as Duration, i.e., in milliseconds or even fractions of a millisecond. However, the Server is not expected to update the value in such a high frequency, but possibly once a minute or once an hour, depending on the application.

model_node_inventory.description: OperationDuration is the duration the Device has been powered and performing an activity. This counter is intended for Devices where a distinction is made between switched on and in operation. For example, a drive can be powered on but not operating. It is not intended for Devices always performing an activity like sensors always measuring data. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted. The OperationDuration is provided as Duration, i.e., in milliseconds or even fractions of a millisecond. However, the Server is not expected to update the value in such a high frequency, but possibly once a minute or once an hour, depending on the application.

model_node_inventory.description: OperationCycleCounter is counting the times the Device switches from not performing an activity to performing an activity. For example, each time a valve starts moving, is counted. This value shall only increase during the lifetime of the Device and shall not be reset when the Device is restarted.

definition_fields.description: If KeepsParameters is not set, the device will lose its configuration during update. The Client should do a backup of the parameters before the update and restore them afterwards.
If WillDisconnect is set, the OPC UA Server will restart during installation. This can be the case if the update is about the firmware of the device that hosts the OPC UA Server.
If RequiresPowerCycle is set, the devices require a manual power off / power on for installation.

If WillReboot is set, the device will reboot during the update, inclusive of embedded infrastructure elements like an integrated switch. An update Client should take this into account since the devices behind an integrated switch are not reachable for that time.
If NeedsPreparation is not set, the Client can install the update without maintaining the PrepareForUpdateStateMachine. This can be used to support an installation without stopping the software.

native_findings.meaning: Three layered models and reusable AddIns
native_findings.assessment: Devices distinguishes base device/component information, communication topology and integration-host representation. Locking and software-update AddIns may also be used outside the model; do not adopt one hierarchy as a universal DIM chassis.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Physical device and broader mechanical/software component roles
native_findings.assessment: Device is a physical entity; ComponentType can describe mechanical or software parts, with concrete SoftwareType. DeviceType mandatory inherited properties may contain designated unsupported defaults; node existence does not prove a known real attribute.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Purpose-oriented functional grouping and user interface resources
native_findings.assessment: Groups can nest and reference the same parameter/property/method from multiple purposes. Organizes membership is not physical part-of. Group visibility may vary with state; UIElement is abstract and concrete UI formats are outside Devices.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Separate product and instance nameplate information, manufacturer identity URI, instance URI, user-writable asset ID/name, patch identifiers and configuration revision counter. A revision counter changes for configuration rather than every measurement.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Device health state and multiple diagnostic conditions
native_findings.assessment: Distinguish the five health values from alarm conditions. Multiple abnormal conditions may coexist; condition messages add causes and corrective suggestions. This does not verify physical device health.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Power-on duration, activity duration and activity-start count differ; monotonic lifetime counters survive restart. Counting details are partly implementation-specific and activity duration is not intended for always-measuring sensors.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Support resources and physical locate indication
native_findings.assessment: Support folders distinguish device images, documents, protocol files and UI images. Locate indication distinguishes supported, selected and active visual/audible signals and finite/infinite duration; this is not coordinates or a verified executed operation.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Discovery roots and block mode roles
native_findings.assessment: DeviceSet exposes roots with reachable subcomponents; DeviceFeatures supports related functionality. Blocks are functional parameter groupings with actual, permitted, normal and target modes, not automatically separate equipment.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Connection points relate devices to logical networks/profiles; symmetric ConnectsTo differs from physical ownership. ConnectsToParent indicates the communication device of a network despite its symmetric declaration. Network locks can extend through subordinate networks.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Host representation and paired offline/online data
native_findings.assessment: Offline leading objects and same-typed online counterparts have distinct NodeIds and matching parameter BrowseNames. Online access is a communication hint; configuration identity can be compared with connected equipment, but objects are not proof of installed-device identity.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Direction, initiation, transfer identity, completion and per-parameter status differ. Locked-device precondition, ordered device-specific transfer, cache invalidation, bounded result retrieval with acknowledgment/retry semantics and no automatic transfer retry must remain explicit.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: A lock has scope, initiator application/user, inactivity timeout and remaining time; ordinary locks may permit reads while exclusive locks may not. Renewal, exit and privileged break differ; forced release can leave inconsistent state.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Software update support and loading strategies
native_findings.assessment: Direct loading installs during transfer; cached loading separates staging from installation and exposes current/pending/fallback roles; filesystem loading has vendor-specific organization. Optional support is discovered, not assumed for all devices.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Firmware, application, configuration and solution are distinct software classes. Software subclass/name identifies managed items; SoftwareFolder Add/Delete concerns collections, not proof of running execution. AddIn identity refers to the updatable component, whose software vendor can differ from hardware manufacturer.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: KeepsParameters, WillDisconnect, RequiresPowerCycle, WillReboot and NeedsPreparation are package/context-qualified declared behavior. Reboot can interrupt downstream infrastructure. Client scheduling and operational process coordination are outside this generic model.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Parameters supports backup/restore around update, not a general backup service. Successful restore does not prove that production or sensing operation has resumed.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Current, Pending and Fallback identify different roles, not all running software. Version identity includes manufacturer URI, revision and patch identifiers, with release date, change-log reference and optional SHA256 content hash. WriteBlockSize and WriteTimeout are transfer constraints, not operation deadlines.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Preparation, installation and manual power-cycle states
native_findings.assessment: Preparation Idle/Preparing/PreparedForUpdate/Resuming differs from installation Idle/Installing/Error and manual WaitingForPowerCycle. PercentComplete is human progress, not completion proof. InstallationDelay is a delay after the installing state is entered, not a schedule guarantee. Install method return does not prove installation or restored operation.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Nonzero ConfirmationTimeout enables confirmation after reconnection and rollback if unconfirmed. Confirming a working connection does not certify functional correctness; timeout is reset after the update and multiple instances coordinate.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: UpdateParent expresses a compatibility-related hierarchy; CanUpdate relates a solution updater to component targets. Neither alone establishes physical containment, current installation, or a task execution dependency.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Software package content and targeting metadata
native_findings.assessment: Package identity/revision/type, descriptive release metadata, target products, deployment payload and supporting release/license/pre-install files are distinct. Metadata-only packages are permitted. Mandatory versus optional fields retain the prose/NodeSet basis; supplied JSON schemas do not enforce all requirements.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: At least one compatibility option must match; requirements within one option must all match. Source defines variable path, typed values and operation, including existence and relative UpdateParent navigation. Comparator descriptions preserve the printed operand direction. OneOf description conflict is held.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Author and additional operator signatures protect package content under ASiC-E/CAdES rules. Unsigned solution policy differs from signed subpackages and authenticated transfer. A hash is not a signature or proof of trust; cryptographic execution and full external PKI standards are outside this assessment.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Solution subpackage assignment and installation order
native_findings.assessment: A solution groups subpackages, assigns them to explicit component/type/identity/path targets and optionally orders installation. Lower order values precede higher values. Assignment is planned deployment, not successful installation; unknown proprietary payload can be wrapped with metadata.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: SupportedTypes enumerates allowable object types separately from configured component instances; allowable types can depend on what is already instantiated. Physical and logical configurations retain their subject. Actual creation mechanism is not specified.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: LifetimeVariable expresses progress from StartValue to LimitValue in common units, counting up or down. WarningValues are ordered by severity, not necessarily numeric increase. Indication distinguishes time, parts, usages, length, diameter and volume. Remaining lifetime is not always time and is not a witnessed replacement event.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Multiple information views of one asset
native_findings.assessment: Composition of companion-model views can represent one physical device through multiple objects. Repeated properties may reference the same value/node; protocol-specific identifiers can differ. Interface/AddIn reuse does not require adopting DeviceType or a universal hierarchy.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Namespace, type, conformance and encoding support
native_findings.assessment: NodeId identity differs from BrowseName and represented physical asset identity. Namespace URI/version/publication and static-node metadata qualify the information model. Categories/documentation map nodes to conformance units, not certified implementations. PackageMetadata usually is not exposed in a server address space.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.meaning: Commercial product code and overall device revision
native_findings.assessment: ProductCode is the manufacturer order/product identifier; Model is a human-readable model designation. DeviceRevision is the overall device revision, distinct from HardwareRevision, SoftwareRevision and the configuration RevisionCounter.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: AssetId is a user-writable asset identifier within the user/integrator context. ComponentName is the user-writable display name. Neither is automatically a manufacturer serial, globally persistent product-instance URI or digital NodeId.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: SupportedIndicationTypes, UsedIndicationType and IsIndicating separate supported audible/visual mechanisms, selected mechanism and reported activity. StartLocationIndication has a bounded duration or zero for indefinite; this is locating by signaling, not geographic coordinates.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: TargetMode is the requested destination operating mode list, distinct from ActualMode, PermittedMode and NormalMode. Its presence is not an issued method-call record or proof that the target was reached.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

native_findings.assessment: Examples illustrate functional-group reuse, identification, loading sequences and solution deployment. They are explanatory evidence, not records of fielded hardware or guaranteed implementations. The black-box package example cannot perform a final client-side version comparison when package versions are unavailable.
native_findings.retained_limits: Native exact fields/state/optionality retained in source declarations and section locators; no observed device instance or model adoption.

candidates.label: Candidate — Manufacturer commercial product identifier
candidates.definition: Identify a manufacturer-orderable product using a commercial product code, retaining producer and product-model context. Keep this code separate from model display name, unit serial, user asset tag and global instance identity.
candidates.addition_rationale: Model designation and unit serial do not preserve an orderable product code.

candidates.label: Candidate — Overall device revision
candidates.definition: Describe the manufacturer overall device revision independently of hardware revision, software revision/patches and configuration change counter. Preserve source applicability and unsupported defaults; no observed installed revision is inferred.
candidates.addition_rationale: Three existing version subjects do not capture the distinct whole-device revision.

candidates.label: Candidate — User-assigned asset identifier
candidates.definition: Identify equipment using a user/integrator-assigned asset tag and its local identification context. Preserve its mutability and distinguish it from manufacturer serial, global product-instance URI and human-readable component name.
candidates.addition_rationale: A mutable local identifier is neither a persistent global identifier nor a display label.

candidates.label: Candidate — Purpose-based information group and shared membership
candidates.definition: Organize parameters, properties and operations into named contextual groups, with nested groups and potentially shared members. Preserve group purpose and state-dependent visibility; informational grouping does not establish a physical subsystem or globally identified record.
candidates.addition_rationale: Existing ISA capability membership and globally identified AAS aspect records do not preserve contextual shared group membership.

candidates.label: Candidate — Multiple information representations of the same asset
candidates.definition: Relate distinct information-model views to the same represented physical asset. Preserve view/protocol context and whether repeated properties share one value/node or have genuinely different meanings. Multiple digital objects do not establish multiple physical devices.
candidates.addition_rationale: Aspect grouping and mediated member exposure do not explicitly record same-asset identity across independent views.

candidates.label: Candidate — Lifetime powered duration, active duration and activity cycles
candidates.definition: Describe cumulative powered duration, duration actively performing work and transitions into activity for an identified device. Keep their counting basis separate, retain implementation-specific counting rules and no-reset lifetime semantics. Unit resolution does not establish reporting frequency.
candidates.addition_rationale: A specialized laser-use count and current activity flag do not preserve these three lifetime counters.

candidates.label: Candidate — Physical asset locating signal support and activity
candidates.definition: Describe supported and selected visual/audible locating signals, reported indication activity and requested duration/start/stop. Keep declaration, selected mechanism, request and observed activity distinct; a locating signal is not a geographic position.
candidates.addition_rationale: Geographic location and generic requests omit the physical locating mechanism and its support/state.

candidates.label: Candidate — Requested destination operating mode
candidates.definition: Describe the operating mode or ordered target-mode choices requested for a block or other qualified subject. Preserve target versus permitted, normal and actual mode; the stored target is not an issued-command event or proof of transition.
candidates.addition_rationale: Supported/default/current modes and issued requests do not preserve an independently stored target mode.

candidates.label: Candidate — Offline planned and online device parameter representations
candidates.definition: Associate the offline configuration representation and online device-access representation of one intended device, retaining correspondence of parameter names and distinct digital identities. Offline database values can differ from physical online values; identity agreement and successful synchronization require evidence.
candidates.addition_rationale: Settings and record history do not capture simultaneous planned/online counterpart roles.

candidates.label: Candidate — Parameter synchronization operation and per-parameter results
candidates.definition: Describe a transfer between configuration storage and a device with transfer identity, direction, initiation status, completion/results sequence and per-parameter diagnostics. Preserve locking preconditions, partial failures and acknowledgement/retry behavior; successful initiation is not successful application.
candidates.addition_rationale: Generic acknowledgement/correlation and log windows omit parameter synchronization semantics.

candidates.label: Candidate — Scoped control lock ownership and lifetime
candidates.definition: Describe whether a qualified object/network is locked, the locking client and user, remaining inactivity lifetime and renew/release/break behavior. Preserve cascaded scope and optional exclusivity; requested lock, granted lock and forced break are separate, and a lock does not prove safe physical action.
candidates.addition_rationale: Existing control request/release rows omit reported ownership, scope and lifetime.

candidates.label: Candidate — Current, staged and fallback software versions
candidates.definition: Associate software version identity and supporting revision/patch/release/hash information with its current, pending or fallback role for a component. Staged content is not installed/running content; a hash identifies bytes but does not establish authenticity. Retain DI-Q003 patch cardinality limit.
candidates.addition_rationale: Running version and package target do not preserve the three simultaneous software roles.

candidates.label: Candidate — Declared update prerequisites and operational side effects
candidates.definition: Describe package/context-specific update preparation needs, parameter preservation/loss, server disconnect, device reboot and manual power-cycle requirements. Account for downstream connectivity impacts where declared. These are anticipated behaviors, not a completed update or general recovery guarantee.
candidates.addition_rationale: Generic applicability conditions and recovery behavior omit explicit update side effects.

candidates.label: Candidate — Update-associated parameter preservation and restoration
candidates.definition: Describe whether and how a software update exposes parameter backup and restoration, keeping saved configuration content, preservation behavior and restore outcome separate. This update-scoped service does not establish a general disaster-recovery backup or restored functional operation.
candidates.addition_rationale: A settings record does not preserve the update backup/restore role.

candidates.label: Candidate — Software update preparation and installation state
candidates.definition: Describe preparation, installation, error recovery and waiting for manual power cycling as separate phases, with qualified progress and optional start delay. Percent complete and successful method return do not prove completion or restored operation. Preserve the Abort transition contradiction DI-Q005.
candidates.addition_rationale: Command execution and running application lifecycle do not preserve update-specific phases and dependencies.

candidates.label: Candidate — Post-update connectivity confirmation and rollback
candidates.definition: Describe the requirement and time window to confirm connectivity after an update, its waiting/confirmed state and rollback consequence if confirmation is absent. Confirmation establishes communication in this source context, not functional correctness or acceptance of all updated equipment.
candidates.addition_rationale: Generic outcome and operation deadline do not preserve confirmation-triggered rollback.

candidates.label: Candidate — Update compatibility hierarchy and updater-to-target capability
candidates.definition: Relate components through update compatibility parentage and identify which components a solution updater can update. Keep the two directed meanings distinct and source-qualified; neither relation proves physical containment, an assigned update or successful installation.
candidates.addition_rationale: Generic relations/dependencies lack these explicit software-update roles.

candidates.label: Candidate — Software package compatibility alternatives and requirements
candidates.definition: Describe package applicability using alternatives of conjunctive requirements on named or relative-path variables, with source-qualified operand values and operations. Preserve AND within an option and OR between options. Comparator direction, OneOf ambiguity and JSON validation limits remain explicit; no universal predicate language adopted.
candidates.addition_rationale: Capability applicability and message filtering do not preserve deployment-package compatibility tests.

candidates.label: Candidate — Software package signature and approval context
candidates.definition: Describe package-content signatures and signer roles, including author integrity/authenticity evidence and additional operator approvals, with trust and unsigned-package policy context. Distinguish outer solution and individual subpackage signatures, transport authentication and hashes. No cryptographic verification or trusted installation is inferred.
candidates.addition_rationale: Connection credentials and secure boot dependencies do not preserve package-level signing and approval roles.

candidates.label: Candidate — Solution subpackage deployment targets and installation order
candidates.definition: Associate a solution subpackage with target component types/instances or qualified identities/paths and optional relative installation order. Retain target server/context and subpackage identity. Assignment describes intended deployment, not physical containment, runtime task assignment or proof of installation.
candidates.addition_rationale: Package-to-target alone and task-to-module assignment omit subpackage grouping, target selection and deployment order.

candidates.label: Candidate — Allowed component types versus configured composition
candidates.definition: Describe which component/object types a configurable subject permits separately from the instances currently configured. Allowable choices may depend on existing instances. Preserve logical versus physical subject and distinguish support declarations from creation mechanism or observed installation.
candidates.addition_rationale: Composition and generic capability list omit allowable-type versus instantiated-component distinction.

candidates.label: Candidate — Lifetime consumption or remaining capacity and warning levels
candidates.definition: Describe lifetime progress for a qualified subject using start, current and end-limit values, shared units, quantity meaning and ordered warning levels. Support increasing or decreasing values and time, use counts, produced parts or material dimensions/volume. Severity order need not equal numeric order; no remaining-service guarantee or completed maintenance inferred.
candidates.addition_rationale: Battery remaining time, laser-use count and health assessment do not preserve general lifetime progress and warning semantics.

classification_policy: Common = potentially reusable information need across equipment contexts, not number of donors. Specialized = update/block/transfer-specific contract retained with native constraints. Gray/uncolored = no supported correspondence or precise unresolved detail. Candidate origin does not establish donor exclusivity.
external_dependency_boundary: UA Parts3/5/6/8/9/20 support identity/types/units/alarms/file-transfer inherited by Devices; only Devices declarations and necessary inline explanations reviewed. ASiC-E/CAdES, UAFX, other companions, certification database internals and runtime implementation are not independently audited.
completion_limits: Reference edition and pinned release reconciled; controlling-document byte parity and external profile database remain unavailable. Specific schema/text/diagram questions are retained. No complete OPC ecosystem, certification, implementation, physical case observation or source-correction claim.

cells.F361: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: ConnectsTo, IsOnline, UpdateParent and CanUpdate carry distinct relation semantics. cells.F363: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: SupportInfo provides product images, documentation, protocol files and UI images; packages add release/license/pre-install files with role, MIME type and language. cells.F371: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: DeviceSet/DeviceFeatures/NetworkSet/DeviceTopology are address-space discovery entry points, not an AAS registry or proof of reachable installed equipment. [DI §§4.10, 4.11, 4.9, 6.1, 6.2, 6.3.1, 6.3.2; DI-N008, DI-N010]
cells.F374: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: WriteTimeout is a direct-loading call constraint; ConfirmationTimeout is a post-update reconnect/rollback interval. Neither equals a client-suggested overall completion deadline. [DI §§8.4.11, 8.4.3, 8.4.4, 8.4.5, 8.4.6, 8.4.7; DI-N017, DI-N019]
cells.F375: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: A software solution associates subpackages and targets; this is deployment packaging rather than a package of AAS records. Software package and assignment meanings have separate targets. [DI §§8.7.1, 8.7.2, 8.7.3, 8.7.5, B.3.6; DI-N021, DI-N024]

cells.F405: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL / RELATED: SoftwareType/SoftwareFolder identify managed software and update lifecycle. Installation state is not the running application start/stop lifecycle; preserve that distinction. [DI §§8.3.2, 8.4.1, 8.4.10, 8.4.12, 8.4.8, 8.4.9; DI-N014, DI-N018]

new_native_findings.meaning: Describe the requirement for a vendor-specific, write-only key to unlock an update feature, its provision before installation or preparation, and its retention for no more than one update.
